data.summary_en: VisualEvolve self-evolves executable visual operations/tool-use strategies via Select–Execute–Evolve–Evaluate; selects skill-library history snapshots by fixed validation-set performance; Progressive Evidence Access graded capability-gap diagnosis limits regression propagation. It beats Initial Skill Library on 23 of 24 settings; Qwen3.5-Plus's maximum gain is 15.1 percentage points on VisualProbe Hard.
